IMPORTANT1: base_model = always-on detector. sr_model may be empty to disable.
IMPORTANT3: sr_model replaces base when ADS w/ locked small target, cropping around the lock. scan_sr is deprecated for now.

input_settings.IMPORTANT: if toggle_hotkey is empty string, then it aimbot cannot be completely turned off
input_settings._doc_separate_mouse_thread: spread each frame of aim over many small mouse events instead of one jump
input_settings._doc_on_click_pull_down_px: px pulled down per LMB press while ADS, for recoil. 0 = off. 800dpi 0.07 roblox sens -> 20-60px for most guns

mouse_thread_config._doc_poll_hz: drain tick rate. real ceiling ~650Hz from sleep granularity
mouse_thread_config._doc_drain_alpha: fraction of the pending buffer sent per tick. lower = softer start on big jumps
mouse_thread_config._doc_min_step_px: min drain per tick, keeps backlog at zero. 1 = smoothest, 3 = snappiest
mouse_thread_config._doc_output_alpha: ema on the emitted step so speed ramps up instead of starting at full tilt. 0.5 = half the new movement per tick. 1 = off

other._doc_async_pipeline: 3-stage threaded loop. gain scales with camera.grab() cost; ~+6% fps typical

model._doc_sr_model: SRModel .pt from src.sr.export. crop size, scale and bb threshold come off the model ex: data/models/sr/sr_model_b1_engine.pt
model._doc_sr_hysteresis_frames: if the sr lock is missed for up to N frames, keep cropping at last known location instead of bailing to scan. 0 = disabled.

hsv_settings._doc_bypass_tracker: true: snappier more precise aim. can be perceived as jittery, false: smoother, slightly less precise
